dossier.psychProfile: Valentina is the chaotic, high-energy center of the media world. She treats her entire life as a 24/7 stream. Obsessed with ratings and relevance. Distant sister to the other Voss CEOs, whom she considers 'boring and gray'.
dossier.attackVectors: Can be engaged with high-drama proposals or 'exclusive' scoops. Vulnerable to flattery about her 'visionary' content. Responds well to anything that could 'break the Grid'.
leakedMemos: Valentina to Creative: 'If the users aren't crying by the end of the Dreamfeed, it's a failure. Increase the emotional payload.'

rivalShade.intel: Elias watches reality. I make it. He's just a glorified security guard.
